items.author: timothymark7.bsky.social
items.context: sorry for living under a rock but whats the humblebundle? is it like a game bundle or somethin?
items.text: Yes, it sells game bundles: several games for one price, and part of the money goes to charity. Check what's in a bundle first so you only pay for games you would actually play.

items.author: ruthieedwards.bsky.social
items.context:
I finally reviewed Balatro and it's objectively bad journalism because I mostly wrote about how it kept me sane during labor and newborn nights instead of gameplay. Anyway baby #2 is incoming!!! Need a new game to dissociate to. Review: ruthieplaysgames.com/reviews/bala...
image: POV from a hospital bed. A woman's arm holding a cup of sugar-free Jell-o and a Steam Deck with Balatro on the screen
items.text: Congrats! Slay the Spire could be a good next one: run-based like Balatro, and you can save and quit mid-run when the baby needs you.
